response.justification: The candidate lacks the mandatory 5+ years of hands-on C++ development on Windows, with only one year of C++ experience at National Instruments (LabWindows/CVI). While they have strong software development experience, their expertise is primarily in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and other languages, with no mention of SQL Server/Oracle proficiency or capital markets/fixed-income domain knowledge.
strengths: Strong general software development and engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, microservices)
Proven ability to work in fast-paced, high-performance environments (millions of requests/second)
Diverse technical background with experience in multiple programming languages and frameworks
concerns: Insufficient C++ experience (only ~1 year) and no Windows platform focus
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle experience (only MongoDB/MySQL mentioned)
No capital markets, investment banking, or fixed-income domain expertise
